overview.name: Polyethylene (PE)
overview.description: A versatile thermoplastic polymer with the simplest structure of all commercial polymers, widely used in packaging, containers, and various industrial applications.
overview.overviewDescription: Polyethylene stands as the most widely produced and used plastic globally, representing the foundation of modern polymer technology. This versatile thermoplastic, with its simple ethylene monomer structure, offers an exceptional combination of properties including excellent chemical resistance, low moisture absorption, and outstanding electrical insulation. PE's versatility spans from flexible packaging films to rigid containers, from household items to sophisticated industrial applications, making it indispensable across virtually every sector of modern industry.
keyFeatures: Excellent chemical resistance and moisture barrier properties
Low density and high strength-to-weight ratio
overview.industrialSignificance: PE is the most important polymer globally, with annual production exceeding 100 million tons. Its versatility, cost-effectiveness, and recyclability make it essential for modern packaging, construction, automotive, and consumer goods industries.

handling: Avoid excessive heat and direct sunlight

hazards: May release fumes at high temperatures
